results.description:
ONE NIGHT. ONE BABY. ONE CASE THAT COULD RUIN EVERYTHING.

George Hiller is always in control. Or at least he was until his law clerk, Veronica Lake, upended his life—with two little pink lines. Now, George has to prove he's the man for her—before their little bundle of joy makes their appearance. 

George needs a plan.

There's just one problem: Ronnie Lake doesn't follow plans. Especially George's.

Ronnie's spent her life keeping her butthead big brothers—Cam, Murdoch, and Anthony—in line. She's not about to let man-in-charge Gorgeous George bulldoze his way into her future, no matter how bossy he is. And she absolutely refuses to be his 'right thing to do!' here, either!

Sure, George's steady declarations of love—and the ridiculously hot way he is the only one to ever call her Veronica—make him harder to resist than she'd like to admit. 

But her trio of brothers? They're starting to rumble loud enough to shake the town and that's the least of Ronnie and George's worries now.

Now a case gone bad has brought real trouble. As secrets unravel and lives hang in the balance, they'll have to decide if love—and a little chaos—is worth fighting for.

Because one surprise baby, three cranky Lake brothers, a little teenage Hiller sister chaos, and sudden danger from a judge with a grudge—that was never part of the plan…
